cells.label: C9 CFP set SS Weapon
cells.gate_formula:
=LET(
  weaponScore, IF(active_ssweapon, af_c_ssweapon, 0),
  chestScore, IF(chaosKeep_sschest="Keep", af_c_sschest, 0),
  neckScore, IF(chaosKeep_ssneck="Keep", af_c_ssneck, 0),
  beltScore, IF(chaosKeep_ssbelt = "Keep", af_c_ssbelt, 0),
  glovesScore, 0,
  bootsScore, 0,
  weaponActive, IF(active_ssweapon, 1, 0),
  totalScore, (weaponScore + chestScore + neckScore + beltScore + glovesScore + bootsScore) * weaponActive,
  totalScore >= 9
)
